narration: In month {fork_month}, after {identical_months} month on the job, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, that same month {first_bar_apart_month}. The ghost's money touched its lowest in month {ghost_lowest_month}, then sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month}, both lives read {real_life} on Life, nearer getting by than living. The ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
